current_source_findings.classification: Bounded current corroboration of a historical rejected suspicion; no new header finding asserted.
current_source_findings.trace: Frame checks a minimum prefix and magic, accepts version 1.0 with short length or 2.0/3.0 with long length, checks the length slice and bounded dictionary/payload split, and requires UTF-8 dictionary text. The dictionary parser requires exactly one descr, fortran_order and shape, rejects unknown/duplicate fields, bad separators/trailing text, unsupported dtype and Fortran order, before admitting shape and payload. NpyArray::from_bytes then retains private shape, dtype and an owned payload copy. Quoted keys/descriptors require an ASCII quote and reject backslash escapes; lexical field parsing is not itself an independently retained partially validated array.
current_source_findings.limits: This is Rust source and control-flow analysis only. It does not establish full NumPy-format conformance, all input-policy decisions, allocator bounds, all public constructor or deserialization routes outside the displayed files, NPZ/ZIP behavior, external callers, or native outcomes.

current_source_findings.classification: Explicit supported scalar and empty storage modes and typed arithmetic safeguards.
current_source_findings.trace: A rank-zero shape has one element; a zero axis gives zero elements before multiplying other dimensions. Nonzero element products and dtype-width multiplication are checked; payload admission requires at least that many bytes and retains only the expected prefix, as the documented trailing-file policy. A native layout checks ordered prefix products for an empty shape separately, and float value upload checks layout/value cardinality before calling Burn.
current_source_findings.limits: Do not replace valid scalars or zero-axis storage with an unconditional nonzero rule. The Burn implementation, allocation limits and actual tensor/device behavior were not inspected or run; accepting an empty storage shape does not guarantee every native layout or device accepts it.

current_source_findings.classification: Previously acknowledged open model/value policy, not a new header failure or unique-count increment.
current_source_findings.trace: Owned projections decode stored fixed-width values and use native casts from f64/integer to f32 and from floating values to i64. The shown conversions contain no independent finiteness, range or model-unit policy. NpyByteStates is explicitly a per-payload-byte zero/nonzero classification; that must not be silently relabeled an elementwise semantic boolean API. The historical q2306/READ-706 already leave scalar/model/native concerns for separate contracts.
current_source_findings.limits: No actual model producer, invalid input, user impact, Burn operation or policy was demonstrated. Whether specific producers must reject nonfinite, lossy or out-of-range values belongs to their consuming model/rig contract and its existing ledger relationships.
